newsitem.title: USA: Chase Capital forms partnership with Aerostar.
newsitem.headline: Chase Capital forms partnership with Aerostar.

text.p: Chase Capital Partners (CCP) said Tuesday it had formed an exclusive strategic partership wtih Robert Paulson and his investment firm Aerostar Capital LLC to make equity investments in the aerospace and defense industry.
Chase Capital Partners will provide equity financing for Paulson as he acquires and builds aerospace and defense suppliers particularly in the U.S., CCP said.
Paulson recently retired after 26 years with consultants McKinsey & Co Inc, where he headed the firm's global aerospace and defense practice.
CCP is a global partnership with approximately $4 billion under management. CCP's sole limited partner is Chase Manhattan Corp.
